```{r load libraries}
library(readxl)
library(SingleR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SCpubr)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
```

Run the analysis for the first replicate of the dataset, SMRU1
```{r assign stages singleR, sample: SMRU1}
# upload reference data to R
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- read_excel("/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/Anthony/Zhu_SciReps_2016.xls", sheet = "SMRU1")

# upload PVP01 orthologs
PVX_PVP01_orthologs <- read_excel("/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/Anthony/GenesByOrthologs_Summary.xlsx")

# process and tidy data
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- as.data.frame(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- left_join(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1, PVX_PVP01_orthologs, by = c("Gid" = "InputOrtholog"))

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- drop_na(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1[, c(2:9)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1) <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1$GeneID
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1[, c(1:7)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)
counts <- as.matrix(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

# convert to summarized experiment
IDC_cycle <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assay = SimpleList(logcounts = counts),
  colData = colnames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)
)
IDC_cycle$X <- NULL

# upload seurat object
pv.combined.all <- readRDS("data/Pv.all.12.Jan2025.rds")

# convert Seurat object to single-cell experiment object for SingleR mapping
sce.all <- as.SingleCellExperiment(DietSeurat(pv.combined.all,
  layers = "data", assays = "RNA"
))

# Run SingleR
pred.IDC.all <- SingleR(
  test = sce.all, ref = IDC_cycle, assay.type.test = 1,
  labels = colnames(IDC_cycle)
)

plotDeltaDistribution(pred.IDC.all, ncol = 3)

# Add SingleR annotations to Seurat object
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels

# Replace NA vaues with "99"
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- pv.combined.all$IDC.pred %>% replace_na("99")

# Convert annotations to factor and relevel
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- factor(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred,
  levels =
    sort(as.numeric(unique(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred)))
)

Idents(pv.combined.all) <- "SRA"

cluster_stats.all <- Cluster_Stats_All_Samples(
  seurat_object = pv.combined.all,
  group_by_var = "IDC.pred"
)

SCpubr::do_BarPlot(pv.combined.all,
  group.by = "IDC.pred",
  split.by = "SRA",
  position = "stack",
  flip = T,
  order = T
)

SCpubr::do_DimPlot(pv.combined.all, group.by = "IDC.pred", dims = c(1, 2), pt.size = 0.1, split.by = "IDC.pred")

SCpubr::do_DimPlot(pv.combined.all, group.by = "IDC.pred", dims = c(1, 3), pt.size = 0.1)
```

Run the same analysis for the second replicate of the dataset, SMRU2
```{r assign stages singleR, sample: SMRU2}
# upload data to R

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- read_excel("Zhu_SciReps_2016.xls", sheet = "SMRU2")

# process and tidy data

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- as.data.frame(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- left_join(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2, PVX_PVP01_orthologs, by = c("Gid" = "InputOrtholog"))

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- drop_na(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2[, c(2:10)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2) <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2$GeneID

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2[, c(1:8)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2)

counts <- as.matrix(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2)

# convert to summarized experiment
IDC_cycle <- SummarizedExperiment(assay = SimpleList(logcounts = counts), colData = colnames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_2))

IDC_cycle$X <- NULL

# convert Seurat object to single-cell experiment object for SingleR mapping
sce.all <- as.SingleCellExperiment(DietSeurat(pv.combined.all, layers = "data", assays = "RNA"))

# Run SingleR
pred.IDC.SMRU2 <- SingleR(test = sce.all, ref = IDC_cycle, assay.type.test = 1, labels = colnames(IDC_cycle))

plotDeltaDistribution(pred.IDC.SMRU2, ncol = 3)

# Add SingleR annotations to Seurat object
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2 <- pred.IDC.SMRU2$pruned.labels
# Replace NA vaues with "99"
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2 <- pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2 %>% replace_na("99")
# Convert annotations to factor and relevel
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2 <- factor(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2,
  levels =
    sort(as.numeric(unique(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2)))
)

Idents(pv.combined.all) <- "SRA"

cluster_stats.SMRU2 <- Cluster_Stats_All_Samples(
  seurat_object = pv.combined.all,
  group_by_var = "IDC.pred.SMRU2"
)

SCpubr::do_BarPlot(pv.combined.all,
  group.by = "IDC.pred.SMRU2",
  split.by = "SRA",
  position = "stack",
  flip = T,
  order = T
)

SCpubr::do_DimPlot(pv.combined.all, group.by = "IDC.pred.SMRU2", dims = c(1, 2), pt.size = 0.1, split.by = "IDC.pred")
SCpubr::do_DimPlot(pv.combined.all, group.by = "IDC.pred", dims = c(1, 3), pt.size = 0.1)
```

Identify cells that are 'potential gametocytes'
```{r identify gametocytes}
femaleGams <- c(
  "PVP01-1207200", "PVP01-0616100", "PVP01-1119300", "PVP01-1465500", "PVP01-1259400", "PVP01-1441000", "PVP01-0702600",
  "PVP01-1306800", "PVP01-0946800", "PVP01-0517400", "PVP01-1027600", "PVP01-1003000", "PVP01-1143200",
  "PVP01-1017500", "PVP01-1024300", "PVP01-0806000", "PVP01-1240300", "PVP01-0603600", "PVP01-0712800"
)

maleGams <- c("PVP01-1262200", "PVP01-0530800", "PVP01-1412100", "PVP01-1025600", "PVP01-1266500", "PVP01-1229400")

pv.combined.all <- AddModuleScore(object = pv.combined.all, features = list(c(femaleGams)), name = "femaleGams_module_score")
pv.combined.all <- AddModuleScore(object = pv.combined.all, features = list(c(maleGams)), name = "maleGams_module_score")

Plot_Density_Custom(seurat_object = pv.combined.all, features = "maleGams_module_score1", custom_palette = PurpleAndYellow())
```
